💡Info
widgets_values:
Bypassing SageAttention/Triton slightly improves quality but significantly increases generation time!

SageAttention and Trition are not installed in the standard ComfyUI. If you don't know how to install them, it's best to ask an AI. I asked [perplexity.ai](https://perplexity.ai) and was successfully guided through the installation step by step. Since the installation varies depending on the system, universal instructions cannot be provided here. Be sure to create a backup of ComfyUI beforehand, as problems during installation can also cause ComfyUI to stop working.

⚠️‼️If the output video is completely black, this indicates an error with the `sage_attention` model. You should then select the model variant that matches your system configuration. Bypass the group if SageAttention and Triton are not installed‼️⚠️

nodes.title: 💡Video Generation Tips
widgets_values:
The **Stage 1 Decoding** is optional. You can bypass this group to skip the process and save time. Note, however, that the optional **color_correction** in **Stage 2 Decoding** only works if decoding has already been performed in **Stage 1**. You can also just bypass the **📺Stage 1 Create Video** group to save a little time.  

Video decoding consumes significant memory. Enable **unload_models** in the **Decoding** nodes to improve speed and prevent out-of-memory errors, even on high-end PCs. On lower-end hardware, you may also need to activate **tiled_vae_decode**. Tiled decoding results in barely visible seams. So try to avoid it if possible.

nodes.title: 👾Known Bug
widgets_values: Restart ComfyUI if the error message `av.error.FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory` appears after an audio recording.

nodes.title: 🎬 Video Generation Workflow Guide
widgets_values:
## 🔄 Generation Modes Switch modes by adjusting the settings in the top left **Text- or Image-to-Video?** node: | Mode | Configuration | |------|---------------| | **Text-to-Video** | Deactivate both `Enable First Frame` and `Enable Last Frame` | | **Image-to-Video** | Activate `Enable First Frame`, `Enable Last Frame`, or both | | **Audio-to-Video & Voice Cloning** | Activate the **🗣️Voice Cloning / Audio to Video** group via the **💤Fast Groups Bypasser** | ## 🎙️ Voice Cloning & Audio Integration ### Voice Cloning Upload a reference clip or record via microphone. The workflow **always extracts a 5-second reference** from your audio: - `audio_start_position`: Sets where the 5-second reference clip begins within your recording. - `identity_guidance_scale`: Controls voice similarity (`3.00` is default). - 💡 *Tip:* Remove background noise (music, wind, etc.) to improve clarity and consistency across frames. ### Audio-to-Video (Lip-Sync) Provide a full audio track to drive mouth movements and ambient sound: - ‼️Match audio duration to video duration for perfect synchronization. **video_length** in the **Trim Audio** node should be the same as **length_in_seconds** in the **Stage 1 Sampler** node. - Set start time and duration to isolate the relevant segment. - 💡 *Tip:* Clean background noise in the source audio for more natural lip-sync and cleaner output. Audio directly influences Stage 1 & 2 generations. ## ⚙️ Core Parameters ### 🧠 Model & Processing - **Two-Stage Pipeline:** LTX 2.3 generates a low-resolution video first, then upscales & refines it. - **Distilled LoRA:** Produces a high-quality base low-res output, making it viable to skip upscaling on lower-end hardware. ### 🔍 Upscalers Configured in the **Load Models** node (last **latent_upscaler** option): | Upscaler | Best For | Notes | |----------|----------|-------| | `1.5x` | Maximum quality | Low-res base stays closer to final resolution, preserving fine details | | `2.0x` | Speed & low VRAM | Faster processing, ideal for limited GPU setups | ### ⏱️ Duration - LTX 2.3 handles long sequences well, but **durations over 20s** may introduce severe distortion. - 💡 *Recommendation:* Keep outputs under 20s for optimal stability and coherence. ### 📐 Dimensions & Resolution | Parameter | Behavior | |-----------|----------| | `width` / `height` | **Text-to-Video:** Sets target resolution directly.
**Image-to-Video:** Only applies if both `megapixel` and `resolution` are set to `0`. | | `megapixel` | Target pixel density. Recommended: `2.10` (~1080p) or `1.00` (~720p). | | `resolution` | Length of the shorter side (e.g., `1088`, `720`). | - 📏 *Auto-Rounding:* Final dimensions are automatically rounded down to the nearest multiple of `96` (1.5x) or `64` (2x) to match model grid requirements. **Stage 1** generates a smaller video scaled by the upscaler factor. ### 🖼️ Image Input Optimization - If your input image is grainy/noisy, increase `start_frame_compression` (start around `30`) in the **Stage 1 Sampler** node to reduce propagated artifacts. - 💡 *Tip:* Only adjust this if needed. Clean inputs require zero compression. ## 🎛️ Sampler & Scheduler Settings *Sampler, scheduler and steps settings can be configured independently for Text-to-Video and Image-to-Video modes.* ### 📉 Understanding Schedulers Schedulers control denoising intensity across steps. **Sigma values** represent this scale: - `1.00` = Start (100% noise) - `0.00` = End (clean final image) #### Why the Default Falls Short The `linear_quadratic` scheduler applies less denoising early and more at the end. Since fine details are refined in the final steps, this leaves too few steps in the critical range, often resulting in overly smooth or artificial-looking video. #### The `bong_tangent` Scheduler (RES4LYF Node) Uses an inverted S-curve to redistribute steps: - **High early sigmas** → Higher contrast, better dynamic range, precise composition. - **Low late sigmas** → Enhanced fine details (critical for skin, hair, textures). - ⚠️ *LTX 2.3 Limitation:* `bong_tangent` often drops sigma well below `0.15`, disrupting LTX 2.3's denoising and causing visible artifacts. #### ✅ Optimized: `videoflow_scheduler` This workflow includes a modified `videoflow_scheduler` that preserves `bong_tangent`'s benefits while avoiding low-sigma artifacts. If this option is enabled, the selected scheduler and denoise value will be ignored. | Parameter | Function | |-----------|----------| | `sigmas_start` | Upper bound (max sigma in first step). ⚠️ Replaces the standard `denoise` value! | | `sigmas_terminal` | Lower bound (min sigma in final step) | | `shift_around_midpoint` | Controls sigma shift direction/magnitude per step toward `sigmas_midpoint` | #### Manual Sigmas (Expert Mode) If you want to override the scheduler's settings and use your own sigma values, enable **use_manual_sigmas** and enter the sigma values in the field below. ### 📊 Recommended Stage 1 Sampler Settings There is no single configuration that works every time. The settings always depend on the scene itself, but also, and especially, on the length and resolution of the video. The settings listed here are intended as a starting point. #### 🖼️ Image-to-Video | Setting | Recommendation | Notes | |---------|----------------|-------| | **Sampler** | `dpm_2_ancestral` (Stage 1) + `dpm_2` (Stage 2) | Alternatives: `exp_heun_2_x0_sde`, `dpmpp_sde_gpu`, `euler_cfg_pp`, `euler_ancestral_cfg_pp` | | **Scheduler** | `videoflow_scheduler` | **sigmas_terminal**: `0.25` for 4 steps, `0.15` for 8 steps | | **Steps** | `4-16` (Default: `4`) if sampler contains `pp` or `2`, `8–32` (Default: `8`) otherwise | Higher steps = better quality | #### 📝 Text-to-Video | Setting | Recommendation | Notes | |---------|----------------|-------| | **Sampler** | `dpm_2_ancestral` (Stage 1) + `dpm_2` (Stage 2) | Alternatives: `exp_heun_2_x0_sde`, `dpmpp_sde_gpu`, `euler_cfg_pp`, `euler_ancestral_cfg_pp` | | **Scheduler** | `videoflow_scheduler` | **sigmas_terminal**: `0.25` for 4 steps, `0.15` for 8 steps | | **Steps** | `4-16` (Default: `8`) if sampler contains `pp` or `2`, `8–32` (Default: `16`) otherwise | Higher steps = better quality | ## ⚡ Performance Tips - 🔍 **Preview Mode:** Enable to check progress early, but **disable for maximum speed**. It significantly slows down generation. - 💾 **VRAM Management:** Use `2.0x` upscaling or skip upscaling (Stage 2) entirely if using low-end hardware.

nodes.title: 💡Stage 2 Video Generation Tips
widgets_values:
### 🌱 Seed Strategy
- **New seed:** Maximum new detail and variation (default).
- **stage_1_seed:** Use to preserve Stage 1's details in Stage 2.

### ⚙️ Sampler, Scheduler & Steps
*Sampler, scheduler and steps settings can be configured independently for text-to-video and image-to-video modes.*

#### 🖼️ Image-to-Video
- **Steps:** `2–16` (default `4`; increase for more details and realism)
- **Sampler:** `dpm_2`
- **Scheduler:** `videoflow_scheduler`
  - `sigmas_start`: `0.68`
  - `sigmas_midpoint`: `0.54`
  - `sigmas_terminal`: `0.10`
  - `shift_around_midpoint`: `0.50`
- **Denoise:** `0.29` (for `linear_quadratic` scheduler)

#### 📝 Text-to-Video
- **Steps:** `2–16` (default `8`)
- **Sampler:** `dpm_2`
- **Scheduler:** `videoflow_scheduler`
  - `sigmas_start`: `0.80`
  - `sigmas_midpoint`: `0.54`
  - `sigmas_terminal`: `0.00`
  - `shift_around_midpoint`: `0.50`
- **Denoise:** `0.44` (for `bong_tangent`), `0.15` (for `linear_quadratic`)

### 🔧 Decoding & Post-Processing
Video decoding is highly memory-intensive. Enable **`unload_models`** in the Decoding nodes to improve speed and prevent out-of-memory errors. On lower-end hardware, also enable **`tiled_vae_decode`** to reduce VRAM usage (seams are barely noticeable).

Enable the **rife_50fps** option to double the frame count for significantly smoother motion. Note that this increases generation time/memory usage. Increasing the value of **rife_clear_cache_after_n_frames** can speed up the process. **rife_fast_mode** reduces quality but is faster. `rife49.pth` is the recommended default checkpoint. `rife47.pth` is a little sharper.

To fix contrast loss and lighting fluctuations, enable **color_correction** in the Decoding node. It transfers Stage 1's color grading to the final output (automatically skipped if **Stage 1 Decoding** is bypassed). `reinhard_lab` is the recommended default method.  
Be aware that color correction is computationally expensive. You can test without it first, or enable it later using fixed seeds. As an alternative or in addition, you can use the **video_filter** to, for example, increase the contrast and reduce the brightness.

By enabling the **video_filter**, you can manually adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, blur, edge and detail enhance. You can additionally add film grain.

### 🎬 Final Output
**CRF (Compression):** Adjust in the **Stage 2 Video** node. Default is `19`. Lower values = less compression, higher quality, but larger file sizes.

nodes.title: 💡Troubleshooting Guide
widgets_values:
### 🎥 Video Quality & Generation
**❌ Video looks completely corrupted/glitched.**  
✅ Check LoRA settings: If using LTX 2.3, ensure the distilled LoRA matches the model (activate only if not built-in) and set strength to exactly `0.60`. Other causes: video duration > 20s or too few steps.

**❌ Artifacts appear in high-motion areas.**  
✅ If using the VideoFlow Scheduler, increase the `terminal` value. Otherwise, increase the step count.

**❌ Deformations or hallucinations in Stage 2.**  
✅ If VideoFlow Scheduler is active, lower the `sigmas_start` value; otherwise, reduce denoise strength. Try changing the Stage 2 seed or syncing it with the Stage 1 seed.

**❌ Deformations or hallucinations in Stage 1.**  
✅ Change the seed. If unresolved, adjust the strength of your active LoRAs.

**❌ Stage 2 video is unsharp.**  
✅ If VideoFlow Scheduler is active, raise the `sigmas_start` value; otherwise, increase denoise. Enable the Video Filter to sharpen slightly, and/or turn on `detail_enhance`.

**❌ Stage 2 video is significantly brighter than Stage 1.**  
✅ Enable color correction. Use the Video Filter to increase contrast and slightly reduce brightness.

**❌ Image appears too soft or blurry.**  
✅ If VideoFlow Scheduler is active, lower the `terminal` value. In Stage 1, switch to a non-ancestral sampler (e.g., `dpm_2`). Increasing steps or reducing duration may also help.

**❌ Colors in Stage 2 are too flat.**  
✅ Especially in portrait orientation, the colors at the top may lack saturation. In such cases, reducing the resolution is the most effective solution. You can also try to lower the `sigmas_start` value, if VideoFlow Scheduler is active; otherwise, reduce denoise strength. Color correction can reduce the problem, too.

### 💬 Dialogue, Subtitles & Audio
**❌ Unwanted subtitles appear.**  
✅ Often fixed by changing the seed. Otherwise, refine your prompt with precise, timed action descriptions and match the video duration to the dialogue. Subtitles frequently occur when processing heavy/fast dialogue. If dialogues are in a different language than your prompt, specify the speaker's nationality or state it's a film from that region.

**❌ Unwanted ambient sound or music appears.**  
✅ Any ambient noise or music in the video that you didn't mention in your prompt is a hallucination. Your prompt needs to be much more specific regarding the general setting of the scene and the audio elements.

**❌ No lip-sync.**  
✅ Try changing the seed first. If using Image-to-Video, ensure the reference image shows a mouth position matching the first word of the audio. Specify facial/lip actions in the prompt. Mismatches between voice characteristics (age, gender) and the reference image can also break sync.

**❌ Unclear or noisy cloned voice audio.**  
✅ Adjust the `identity_guidance_scale` value (start at `0.00`). Ensure high-quality audio references, and use `Voice Separation` to remove background noise.

### 🐛 Known Issues
**❌ `av.error.FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory` after audio recording.**  
✅ Known ComfyUI bug. Restarting ComfyUI typically resolves it.

nodes.title: ℹ️Workflow Setup
widgets_values:
# VideoFlow LTX 2.3 All-in-One v3.0

This is a LTX 2.3 workflow supporting text-to-video, image-to-video (first frame, last frame), audio-to-video and stable character voice via TalkVid ID-LoRA.

⚠️‼️This workflow requires at least ComfyUI v0.20.1 (2026-04-27) and all node models updated to the latest version.‼️⚠️

## Required Models

### LTX 2.3 Model

You can load the LTX 2.3 model in three formats:

- **Checkpoint**: Video VAE included (extra video VAE file will be ignored).  
- **GGUF**: About twice as slow, but suitable for low VRAM+RAM when other models are too large.  
- **Diffusion Model**: Video VAE not included. 

#### Low VRAM info

Tests using a GeForce graphics card with 12 GB of VRAM and 32 GB of RAM have shown that the fp8 distilled checkpoint performs better (faster, better output quality) than any GGUF model, even those smaller than 12 GB. ComfyUI has excellent memory management, allowing the 29.5 GB of the model to be loaded across both VRAM and RAM. No special configuration of ComfyUI was required for this, no extra parameters at startup. 1080p videos (2.1 megapixels) with a length of 15 seconds could be generated without any memory or performance issues. 

#### Notes for the Workflow

- This workflow is designed for the **distilled 1.1 model**.  
- If you use a non-distilled model, add the **distilled-1.1-LoRA** at a strength of **0.6**.  
- Using a distilled model (distilled-LoRA already included) saves memory and generates slightly faster.  
- Tests show image quality is similar with or without extra distilled-LoRA, but **emotions and liveliness** are better without it.  


If you can't decide which of the available options to download, the recommendations are marked with 👍.

#### Option 1: Checkpoint
Save path 📂`ComfyUI/models/checkpoints`:  

[Download bf16 46.1 GB](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/resolve/main/ltx-2.3-22b-dev.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-22b-dev.safetensors`  
or  
[Download bf16 distilled 1.1 46.1 GB](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/resolve/main/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1.safetensors`  
or  
[Download fp8 29.1 GB](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3-fp8/resolve/main/ltx-2.3-22b-dev-fp8.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-22b-dev-fp8.safetensors`👍    
or  
[Download distilled fp8 29.5 GB](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3-fp8/resolve/main/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-fp8.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-fp8.safetensors` (⚠️old distilled 1.0)  
As of now (April 29, 2026), the fp8 version of the distilled 1.1 checkpoint is unfortunately not yet available. Once it is released, that is the recommended version! You will find the download here: [https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3-fp8/tree/main](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3-fp8/tree/main)   

#### Option 2: GGUF
Save path 📂`ComfyUI/models/unet`:  

[Download](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/LTX-2.3-GGUF/tree/main/distilled-1.1) Various sizes are available; ⚠️GGUF is slow!  

#### Option 3: Diffusion Model
Save path 📂`ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models`:  

[Download bf16 42 GB](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.3-22b-dev_transformer_only_bf16.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-22b-dev_transformer_only_bf16.saftetensors`  
or  
[Download distilled 1.1 bf16 42 GB](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_transformer_only_bf16.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_transformer_only_bf16.safetensors`  
or  
[Download fp8 25 GB only for Nvidia GeForce RTX50xx/40xx](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors`  
or  
[Download distilled 1.1 fp8 24.1 GB only for Nvidia GeForce RTX50xx/40xx](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_transformer_only_mxfp8_block32.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_transformer_only_mxfp8_block32.safetensors`👍   
or  
[Download fp8 23.5 GB](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_scaled.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_scaled.saftetensors`  
or  
[Download distilled 1.1 fp8 25.2 GB](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_transformer_only_fp8_scaled.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_transformer_only_fp8_scaled.safetensors`

### LTX 2.3 Distilled 1.1 LoRA

The LoRA is only needed if you are using a non-distilled model. **Add the LoRA with a `strength` of `0.6`!**  

Save path 📂`ComfyUI/models/loras`:  

[Download 7.61 GB](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/resolve/main/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384-1.1.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384-1.1.safetensors`  
or  
[Download 2.74 GB](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/loras/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_111_bf16.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_111_bf16.safetensors`👍

### Optional LoRAs for Realism

This combination of LoRAs produces a particularly realistic neutral look:

Save path 📂`ComfyUI/models/loras`:  

[Download 168 MB](https://civitai.red/models/2530917/amateur-hour-ltx-23) `AmateurHour_01_rank16.safetensors` (`strength 0.50`)  
[Download 336 MB](https://civitai.red/models/2535622?modelVersionId=2849706) `LTX2.3_Soft_Enhance.safetensors` (`strength 0.30`)  
[Download 1.88 GB](https://civitai.red/models/2200329?modelVersionId=2808759) `LTX23-GalaxyAce.safetensors` (`strength 0.35`)  
[Download 672 MB](https://civitai.red/models/2535622?modelVersionId=2849716) `LTX2.3_Crisp_Enhance.safetensors` (`strength 0.25`)  
[Download 336 MB](https://civitai.red/models/2538555/ltx-23-luxe-sensual?modelVersionId=2852957) `Luxe_Sensual.safetensors` (`strength 0.20`)  

The LoRAs are particularly well-suited for text-to-video generations, but they also work in image-to-video mode, where the image itself, rather than the LoRAs, determines the quality.

### Optional LoRA for Voice Cloning

[Download 1.13 GB](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ltx-2.3/resolve/main/split_files/loras/ltx-2.3-id-lora-talkvid-3k.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-id-lora-talkvid-3k.safetensors`

### Optional Voice Separation Model

If you want to remove background noise from a voice recording, you'll need the Mel-Band RoFormer model.

Save path 📂`ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models`:  

[Download 456 MB](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MelBandRoFormer_comfy/resolve/main/MelBandRoformer_fp16.safetensors?download=true) `MelBandRoformer_fp16.safetensors`👍  
or    
[Download 913 MB](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MelBandRoFormer_comfy/resolve/main/MelBandRoformer_fp32.safetensors?download=true) `MelBandRoformer_fp32.safetensors`

### Text Encoders

Save path 📂`ComfyUI/models/text_encoders`:  

[Download 2.31 GB](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/text_encoders/ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors`  

[Download 24.4 GB](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ltx-2/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/gemma_3_12B_it.safetensors?download=true) `gemma_3_12B_it.safetensors`  
or  
[Download 9.45 GB](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ltx-2/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed.safetensors?download=true) `gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed.safetensors`👍   

### VAEs

Save path 📂`ComfyUI/models/vae`: 

[Download 365 MB](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/vae/LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors?download=true) `LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors`  
[Download 1.45 GB](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/vae/LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors?download=true) `LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors` (not required when using a checkpoint)  
[Download 23.5 MB](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/resolve/main/vae/taeltx2_3.safetensors?download=true) `taeltx2_3.safetensors`  

### Latent Upscale Models

Save path 📂`ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models`:  

[Download 1.09 GB](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/resolve/main/ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x1.5-1.0.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x1.5-1.0.safetensors`  
[Download 996 MB](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/resolve/main/ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors?download=true) `ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors`

## Installation

### ComfyUI Manager Installation
[https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager?tab=readme-ov-file#comfyui-manager](https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager?tab=readme-ov-file#comfyui-manager)

### Installation of Missing Nodes

Missing nodes in this workflow are highlighted in red. To install them, open the ComfyUI Manager and click the 'Install Missing Custom Nodes' button. 

After the installation, restart ComfyUI and refresh the browser page.

## Performance Tips
Make sure you're using the latest graphics card driver. For example, Nvidia released a new version in March 2026 that provided a noticeable performance boost.

You should also keep ComfyUI up to date, not just the nodes. New versions often include performance improvements as well.  

It's only a small improvement, but disabling graphics/hardware acceleration in your browser will free up a bit of VRAM, which can make the difference between slow data swapping and fast VRAM-only usage. Be sure to restart the browser after changing this setting. Keep in mind that this will negatively affect your browser's performance, particularly when watching high-resolution videos. Therefore, this is a temporary improvement intended only for ComfyUI. If you have a video player like VLC open while using ComfyUI, it is recommended to disable hardware acceleration in the Codecs settings as well.

## TL;DR

Check my Civitai profile for updates and other workflows: [https://civitai.red/user/ai839](https://civitai.red/user/ai839)  

I would appreciate a positive review 👍 for this workflow on Civitai.

nodes.title: 💡Frame Rate Info
widgets_values: As of April 2026, it's unclear whether this is intentional or a bug, but ComfyUI currently requires audio to use a 24 fps frame rate and video to use 25 fps to keep them in sync.

inputs.text: A medium close-up shot features a Caucasian man with a closely shaven head and face, wearing a black baseball cap with "PNTR" in white letters on the front, and a dark grey t-shirt with "JUST DO IT" visible across his chest. A small black microphone is clipped to his shirt collar. He is positioned slightly to the left of the frame, looking intently downwards and to his right, his eyes focused off-camera.
